operation.summary: Ask Jev typed questions about text/JSON, or Clef about one retained sound/wake-word clip (audio is sent to the decision backend); run matching conditional actions

body.name: model
body.description: jev (default), clef (retained audio), or glm (GLM 5.3 Flash through OpenRouter)

body.name: audio_clip_id
body.description: With model clef: one retained clip id from sound.heard or listen.heard; needs its enabled sound/wake-word grant. Sends the clip to Clef; no new recording or local sound-model download.

body.name: state
body.description: What the questions are about: text or JSON, up to about 512 KB. Text/JSON context; use model clef plus audio_clip_id to classify a retained audio clip

body.name: questions
body.description: 1-50 typed questions, {id: {type: choice|noul|..., instructions, criteria?}}, as https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives

body.name: actions
body.description: Up to 10 rules, bridgit-actions/1: {id, when: condition or 1-5 conditions (all must hold), do: action}. Condition: {answer, choice, min_confidence?} or {answer, min?, max?} for a probability. Action: {type: notice, title, text?} (a card from you), {type: speak, text} or {type: log, message}; plain text only, no links

operation.example: POST /v1/judgment {"state":{"battery_percent":12,"charging":false},"questions":{"charge":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Should the owner plug in before a two-hour call?","criteria":{"yes":"Plug in first","no":"Fine as it is"}}},"actions":[{"id":"plug_in","when":{"answer":"charge","choice":"yes","min_confidence":0.8},"do":{"type":"notice","title":"Plug in before your call","text":"Battery is at 12%."}}]}
operation.returns: model, answers {id: {type, choice+confidence | noul}}, usage, cost_usd, elapsed_ms, actions_schema (bridgit-actions/1), actions [{id, type, reason, ran, error?}] (only rules whose conditions held), skipped [{id, reason}]. When Jev fails you get an error and no action runs
